text:
zach: FYI planning to unpin runtime v2.15 in the 'quant-canary-orbit' cohort tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Purpose: validate new kernel heuristics with redwood-llama3q-quant-v2 and measure p95 under mixed short/long payloads. SDK 4.2.0 required for kernel headers; gateway will block older clients. Any objections?

deploybot: Pin snapshot: runtime:v2.15 -> pinned, model:redwood-llama3q-quant-v2 -> soft-pin, sdk:4.1.x -> blocked. Planned command: `deploybot unpin --runtime v2.15 --cohort quant-canary-orbit --at 2026-03-26T03:00Z`. Auto-pin rule: header_errors > 50 && err_rate > 0.3% -> `deploybot pin --runtime v2.15`.

lina: QA notes: schedule warmup at 02:15 UTC for 30m (`ci/canary-warmup`). Smoke checks: p95 delta < 30% and kv_hit > 92%. I'll watch error-rate and structured-call 422s.

kevin: infra: longseq fallback will route >16k token requests to runtime:v2.14 compat shim. Also recommend `kvcache-warmup=true` before unpin to avoid cold miss spikes.

zach: added warming job, and set alert: if kv_hit < 90% OR token_error_rate > 0.5% -> immediate pin back.

lina: Preflight results (CI):
```
warmup: PASS kv_hit 95%
latency: p95 172ms baseline 160ms
errors: 0.08%
```
All green.

opsbot: @oncall assigned kevin for 03:00-04:00 UTC. PagerDuty escalation at 03:10 if auto-pin triggers.

kevin: I'll monitor p95/kv_hit/header_errors. If I see header mismatch 422s escalate to gateway team and pin.

zach: Release note bullets drafted: - Unpin runtime v2.15 in quant-canary-orbit - SDK 4.2.0 required (X-RW-Kernel header) - Fallback to v2.14 for >16k tokens - Rollback: `deploybot pin --runtime v2.15` + `routectl set --cohort quant-canary-orbit --to runtime:v2.15`

lina: Python wheel uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/pkgs/sdk/python/4.2.0. Node/Go already published.

zach: If no blockers by 02:40 UTC I'll trigger unpin at 03:00. Keeping thread open for rollback notes and postmortem anchors.
